stationSpecificFees.reason: REWAG states that blocking fees apply only at specifically marked stations. AC: 0.02 EUR/min between 09:00-19:00 from minute 121; DC: r.charge 0.05 EUR/min and direct payment 0.10 EUR/min from minute 61. Do not apply these fees to an EVSE unless the station is explicitly marked by REWAG.

roamingDeferred.reason: Official REWAG page states third-party card prices depend on the eMSP; these are not the physical CPO tariff.

note: Official own-network energy prices verified 2026-09-04. No national blocking-fee fallback is allowed because REWAG explicitly limits those fees to selected marked stations.
